content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: Save on sales invoice:new returns a visible validation error with no field identified in the events (609:e687 and 671:e750 after clicks 608 and 669), and the user edits Customer (612, 614, 638) and Payment Due Date (674, 676) between attempts, so the error is probably tied to a required field that is not clearly pointed out at the point of failure.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new screen, when the Save button's validation fails, move focus to the first invalid field (for example Customer or Payment Due Date) and place its error message next to that field, instead of only showing a generic visible error block.", "cited_event_ids": ["608", "609:e687", "612", "614", "638", "669", "671:e750", "674", "676"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The error text and the invalid field name are not present in the events, so the specific failing field is not verified.", "Whether the user's edits to Customer and Payment Due Date changed the validation outcome is not shown; the second Save still produced an error.", "The 3.0 s per loop and the median loss figure come from the insight facts and were not re-measured from the windows.", "The window covers only one session, so it cannot show whether other users hit the same error.", "It is not shown whether the later Save (694) and Submit (780) completed successfully, since only overlay coverage events follow.", "Dropped pointer samples (655) mean some pointer movement between attempts is missing."]}
